# NeetoForm

NeetoForm is an online form builder for collecting submissions and managing workspace team members.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/neetoform/.

## Actions

- **Invite Team Members**: Invite one or more email addresses to the workspace, optionally choosing their role, inviter, and whether NeetoForm sends invitation email.
- **List Form Submissions** (read-only): Return one page of submissions for a specific form in the connected workspace.
- **List Forms** (read-only): Return one page of forms in the connected NeetoForm workspace, including IDs needed to list submissions.
- **List Team Members** (read-only): Return one page of workspace team members, including IDs needed to update or remove a member.
- **Remove Team Member**: Destructively remove one team member from the workspace by ID.
- **Update Team Member**: Update selected profile or workspace-role fields for one team member.
